tasks.title: Upgrade FFmpeg to a version with HEVC decoder
tasks.notes: Downloaded FFmpeg n7.1 (libavcodec 61) from BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds: ffmpeg-n7.1-latest-win64-lgpl-shared-7.1.zip. Created libs/ffmpeg-n7.1-lgpl-shared/ with include/ (headers) and x64/lib/ (import .lib files). DLLs excluded from git (too large, ~120MB); README.txt in x64/bin/ documents download source. win32 builds not available from BtbN for FFmpeg 7.x (only x64 provided). Updated FFMpegDir in all 4 vcxproj files to reference new directory. Confirmed: AV_CODEC_ID_HEVC present in include/libavcodec/codec_id.h; avcodec_alloc_context3 and avcodec_open2 in avcodec.h; av_frame_alloc in frame.h. Note: avcodec_decode_video2 REMOVED in FFmpeg 4.0+; must update to avcodec_send_packet/avcodec_receive_frame in Task 2.2.

tasks.title: Update FFmpeg API calls for new version
tasks.notes: Updated VideoDecoder.hpp for FFmpeg 7.1 API: (1) Removed av_register_all() and avcodec_register_all() — removed in FFmpeg 4.0, codecs auto-register now; (2) avcodec_alloc_context() -> avcodec_alloc_context3(avCodec); (3) avcodec_open() -> avcodec_open2(avCodecContext, avCodec, NULL); (4) avcodec_alloc_frame() -> av_frame_alloc(); (5) av_free(avFrame) -> av_frame_free(&avFrame); (6) avcodec_close+av_free -> avcodec_free_context; (7) avcodec_decode_video2 -> avcodec_send_packet + avcodec_receive_frame send/receive API; (8) CodecID type -> AVCodecID in VideoDecoder.hpp, Live555.hpp, and Live555.cpp. Also added AV_CODEC_ID_HEVC to the CODEC_FLAG2_CHUNKS check in Init().
